occasions.label: Nurses Week
occasions.reason: outstanding compassion, adaptability and resilience during Nurses Week (one week of appreciation, fifty-one weeks of ratios)
occasions.fine: Appreciation is observed for the duration of the week. Ratios are observed at management's discretion.

occasions.label: The “Heroes” banner
occasions.reason: being described as a hero on a banner in the main lobby
occasions.fine: Hero status confers no overtime, hazard pay or chair.

occasions.label: Surviving a Joint Commission visit
occasions.reason: successfully pretending the unannounced survey was a normal Tuesday
occasions.fine: Recipient is asked to resume not having enough supplies on Wednesday.

occasions.label: Covering an extra shift
occasions.reason: generously covering a shift that was described as voluntary
occasions.fine: Voluntary means voluntold. Slice may be consumed standing.

occasions.label: Surviving the EHR upgrade
occasions.reason: navigating the latest EHR upgrade and its “minor workflow enhancements”
occasions.fine: Recipient's click count has increased by 40 percent. This is a feature.

occasions.label: Doctors’ Day
occasions.reason: Doctors’ Day, which this institution is proud to observe by email
occasions.fine: Pizza may be substituted with a link to a wellness webinar.

occasions.label: “Unprecedented times”
occasions.reason: extraordinary resilience during unprecedented times (now in their ninth consecutive year)
occasions.fine: Unprecedented is a term of art meaning “again”.

occasions.label: Patient satisfaction survey season
occasions.reason: maintaining a warm smile while being scored on a five-point scale by a survey that also asks about the parking
occasions.fine: Parking is not within the recipient's control. Neither is anything else.

occasions.label: Beating the “productivity” target
occasions.reason: exceeding this quarter's productivity target, which has been raised for next quarter
occasions.fine: Target has been raised. Slice has not.

occasions.label: Something else (write your own)
occasions.fine: Awarded in recognition of everything nobody wrote down.

lines.text: I am currently charting from 2019 and will respond as soon as I reach the present.
I am out of the office and inside the EHR, which is worse. I will reply when the note saves.
I have gone to finish my notes. Please do not send search parties. They will only add to my inbox.
I am unavailable until I click every box. There are 41 boxes. I have found 40.
I am pending signature. Please check back after I am done or after I retire, whichever is later.
Currently documenting the documentation. Reply time: unknown.
I am on call and will respond to your message after the pager stops, which it has not since 2022.
I am on call. If your matter is urgent, please page. If it is not urgent, please reconsider why you emailed.
On call. I may reply within minutes or after several days. My phone and I have discussed it.
I am on call this week, which means I am technically here, technically off, and technically not asleep.
The on-call physician is unavailable to answer your question about the on-call schedule.
I am post-call and legally a different person. Please write to that person after tomorrow.
I am post-call. Anything I say today is not a decision and not a promise. It is mostly noise.
Post-call. I am asleep, or wishing I were. Please leave a message after the horizon.
I am recovering from a night shift. I will reply when I can remember my name and yours.
I am in a meeting that could have been an email. This message is the email.
I am in back-to-back meetings until the end of the quarter. Please resend when the quarter ends.
I am currently at the committee that oversees the committee. Back when it adjourns.
I am attending a mandatory wellness webinar. Please do not contact me. I am learning to relax.
I am in a listening session. Please wait until it is done to be heard.
I am on vacation. I am not checking email. I am not thinking about you. I am thinking about a beach, and it is a good beach.
I am out until the 14th. If this is a medical emergency, hang up and call 911. If it is a staffing emergency, welcome to my vacation.
Away, and for once no one is holding my pager. Back soon, or possibly not. We will see how the beach looks.
I will return refreshed and ready to do more with less. Less is the plan.
I am on leave and my inbox has been placed on hold. It has been on hold since 2018 and is doing fine.
I am out of the office and out of spoons. Both will be restocked shortly. Neither is in the budget.
I will reply to your message as soon as I have finished the four other things I was asked to do at the same time.
Thank you for your email. Your message is important to us, which is why we have placed it at the bottom of a very long pile.
Your message has been received. It has been assigned a ticket number, which will not be told to anyone.
I am out. If it helps, everyone else is out too. We are all out. We are all still here.
This is an automated reply. If a human reply is needed, please lower your expectations first.
I am on a break. I am told it is protected. I have not yet seen the protection.
For questions about this message, please contact my supervisor, who is also out, for the same reasons.
